course_name_original: Empresa: Introducción a la gestión empresarial

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the role of the company in the economic activity.
Understand the basic aspects that characterize different types of companies.
Understand the legal framework of different types of companies.
Understand the most relevant aspects of organization and management in the company.
Acquire skills regarding the processes that affect business management.

syllabus_topics: Topic 2: The Financial System (PART I). Economic and Financial Structure of the Company
Economic and financial structure of the company
Operating cycle and average collection period
Topic 3: The Financial System (PART II). Company Results
Topic 4: The Financial System (PART III). Investment
Criteria for evaluating and selecting investments
Topic 5: The Financial System (PART IV). Financing
Analysis of company solvency and liquidity
Topic 6: The Production System (PART I). General Aspects
Topic 7: The Production System (PART II). Production Costs
Practice 1: Application of concepts from topic 1

assessment_rules: For continuous assessment, the final grade is 30% from the first test, 30% from the second, and 40% from the third. It requires passing 75% of practical exercises and a minimum of 4/10 on the third test. For global assessment (or July resit), the grade is 30% from a multiple-choice theory test and 70% from a practical test, with a minimum of 5/10 required on the theory test to pass the subject. Unethical behavior, unauthorized electronic device use, or unauthorized AI tool use will result in a 0.0 grade.
